code._comment: Fallback copy localized by CoreError code. Purpose: shown only when message is missing/empty (the normal path prefers the raw message — a complete user-facing sentence), and serves as the anchor for future per-code branches (e.g. conflict guidance, permission requests). Programmatic branching must check code, never match this copy.

code.protected: Built-in system variable; it cannot be modified or deleted.
code.reservedName: This name is managed by the dedicated PATH channel; edit it in the PATH view.
code.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
code.nameExists: A variable with this name already exists; use the edit function.
code.notFound: The target variable no longer exists; refresh the list.

help.content:
PathEditor v{{version}} — Windows System Environment Variable (PATH) Editor

Features:
• Create/Edit/Delete path entries
• Move Up/Down to adjust priority
• One-click cleanup of invalid & duplicate paths
• Import/Export JSON, CSV, TXT formats
• Full Undo/Redo support

Shortcuts:
• Ctrl+N New
• Ctrl+S Save
• Ctrl+Z Undo
• Ctrl+Y Redo
• Ctrl+F Search
• Delete Delete selected
• F1 Help

Author: 刘航宇
GitHub: https://github.com/LHY0125/PathEditor
